brief.title: Choose prompt/context shimming, LoRA weight update or hybrid routing
brief.plain_summary: Compare knowledge churn half-life, daily query volume, context shim token overhead and instant-revocation needs against LoRA training cost to choose the right adaptation mechanism.
brief.outcome: Selected strategy, horizon token amortization and breakeven query count.

routing_spec.description: Pin of churn, volume and token budget parameters.
